Question: Assalam o alaykum, Salam o alaykum, What is the ruling on those who believe that Holy Prophet knew the Quran even before his birth (Qabal wiladat hi arif-i-Quran thay). But He Nabi didn't propagate it until it was revelaved to him through Jibrail? JazakAllah. Answer ID: 14870 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1317/1317=M/1430) It is not proved by the Quran and Hadith that the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) knew the Quran before his birth. Therefore holding such a belief is not right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
